assessment.rationale: Text-to-floor-plan generators exist, but none produces buildable, permit-ready plans, so the Main KPI of 1,000,000,000 people able to generate buildable home plans is unmet. Independent guides say no AI floor plan generator yet produces drawings a building department accepts; outputs are schematic (https://www.maket.ai/blog/ai-floor-plan-generator-guide-2026). Maket and similar tools give basic code hints only (https://archgyan.com/maket-ai-floor-plan-generation-residential/); open research such as HouseDiffusion generates vector layouts without structure or code (https://github.com/aminshabani/house_diffusion). AI permit pre-checks such as Archistar with the ICC check plans against code for reviewers but do not author them (https://www.iccsafe.org/about/periodicals-and-newsroom/international-code-council-collaborates-with-archistar-to-modernize-permitting-and-accelerate-housing-development). Honest limit: schematic layout generation and rule-based code checking are known answers; new work is the gap between them (structure, services, jurisdiction-specific compliance and a licensed sign-off path), and vendor permit-ready claims were not independently verified.

additionalSearches.query: AI generate house floor plan permit ready construction drawings from text description
additionalSearches.finding: Text-to-floor-plan tools are common; independent sources say none produce drawings building departments accept; output is schematic.

additionalSearches.query: Maket.ai generative residential floor plans users limitations building code
additionalSearches.finding: Maket includes basic code considerations but is not a substitute for licensed code review; no independent accuracy tests found.

additionalSearches.query: open source house plan generator github floor plan generation diffusion HouseDiffusion
additionalSearches.finding: HouseDiffusion is open-source vector floor plan generation trained on RPLAN; layouts only, no structure or code compliance.

additionalSearches.query: automated building code compliance checking residential plans AI 2025 permit
additionalSearches.finding: Archistar and the ICC deploy AI pre-checks for single-family permits; checks plans for reviewers, does not generate buildable plans.
